column1: # FileMaker index keys observed in files FileMaker Server 26.0.3's engine wrote (tools/fms-script-harness, query-program.md 7.1-7.3).
# value escapes: \r \n \t \\, \u{hex} for invisible code points, c{n} for n copies of c; in keys, hhhh{n} is n copies of a 2-byte weight.
# Text rows: language 21 for every value; System (1) keys equal Unicode standard (3) here and are left out;
# other languages only where their keys differ from 21's. ff80 = the long-key entry, 01 = the empty value's key, feff = an invalid value.
# Typed rows (number, time, timestamp, date): the value as set, "=calc" when set by a calculation, and the stored text when it differs.
# kana rows: one character and the weights it adds to a Japanese (31) key, from the value-index keys of the kana strings above.
